summary_1line: Vishnu empowers Indra and his thunderbolt to kill the ascetic Asura Vritra, after which Indra is afflicted by the sin of brahmanicide.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra hurls the blazing thunderbolt at the radiant giant Vritra, the weapon striking his head like the fire of cosmic destruction.
The terrified gods stand before the immense, glowing figure of Vritra whose radiance seems to consume the sky and worlds.
After the killing, the sin of brahmanicide pursues Indra across the ends of the world as he flees in fear.
